## inputActions.resetPlayerBindings

Deletes the players' bindings of the project's game: the file &lt;project&gt;/.strata/Saves/InputBindings.json that a rebinding menu wrote with Input:\:SaveBindings while the game played here, and that every play session starts with, so that the project's bindings apply again (while the file rebinds an action, inputActions.setAction's bindings do not reach play mode for it; the Input Actions page marks those actions). While playing, the running game also gets the project's bindings back from its next frame. Not undoable, like the game's saves. Returns reset: the actions whose players' bindings were dropped.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputActionsCommands.cpp:461`

No parameters.

}

## inputActions.setAction

Adds, changes, moves or removes an action of the project's input actions (the project settings section Input.Actions). The action is named &quot;&lt;Map&gt;/&lt;Action&gt;&quot; or by a bare name no other map has; an unknown one is added to its map (the map in its name, or map; inputActions.setMap adds maps) with kind (Button, the default; Axis: one value from -1 to 1; Vector2: two, +Y up), deadZone (Axis and Vector2: 0 to 0.9, default 0.15) and bindings. An existing one takes the changes given: rename, kind (its bindings must fit the new kind, or give new ones), deadZone, bindings (replaces the whole list, at most 8), map (moves it), or remove: true. Bindings are texts: Key/&lt;key&gt;, Mouse/&lt;button&gt;, Gamepad/&lt;button&gt;; Gamepad/&lt;axis&gt;, Gamepad/&lt;axis&gt;+ or -, Gamepad/LeftStick or RightStick; 1D:&lt;negative&gt;,&lt;positive&gt; and 2D:&lt;up&gt;,&lt;down&gt;,&lt;left&gt;,&lt;right&gt; of button-like controls. The UI map's Submit, Cancel, Up, Down, Left and Right (the game UI's navigation) take new bindings but cannot be renamed, moved, removed or made another kind. One undo step that leaves the scene saved; writes the project file in the background. Allowed while playing: the running game reads the change in its next frame. Returns action ({name, kind, deadZone, bindings, reserved}) and created, or removed.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputActionsCommands.cpp:256`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string | yes |   | The action: &quot;&lt;Map&gt;/&lt;Action&gt;&quot;, or a bare name no other map has. |
| `bindings` | array of string | no |   | Key/&lt;key&gt;, Mouse/&lt;button&gt;, Gamepad/&lt;button&gt; (InputNames' names, any gamepad); Gamepad/&lt;axis&gt; (whole axis), Gamepad/&lt;axis&gt;+ or - (half axis; triggers only +), Gamepad/LeftStick or RightStick; 1D:&lt;negative&gt;,&lt;positive&gt; and 2D:&lt;up&gt;,&lt;down&gt;,&lt;left&gt;,&lt;right&gt; of keys, mouse and gamepad buttons and half axes. Items: at most 8. |
| `deadZone` | number | no |   | Axis and Vector2: values within it read 0, the rest is rescaled to reach 1 (round for vectors). Value: at least `0`, at most `0.9`. |
| `kind` | any | no |   | Button, Axis or Vector2. One of: `Button`, `Axis`, `Vector2`. |
| `map` | string | no |   | The map to add the action to, or to move it to. |
| `remove` | boolean | no |   | Removes the action (no other change may be given). |
| `rename` | string | no |   | A new name for the action (unique in its map, ignoring case). |

## inputActions.setMap

Adds, changes or removes a map of the project's input actions (the project settings section Input.Actions; project.settings shows them all): a map unknown so far is added (enabled says whether its actions work when the game starts, default true); an existing one is renamed (rename) or enabled at start or not (enabled), or removed with its actions (remove: true). The map UI is reserved for the game UI's navigation and cannot be renamed or removed. Names are 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces, '\_', '-' and '.', unique ignoring case; at most 32 maps. One undo step that leaves the scene saved; writes the project file in the background. Allowed while playing: the running game reads the change in its next frame. Returns map ({name, enabled, reserved, actions}) and created, or removed.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorInputActionsCommands.cpp:171`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | no |   | Whether the map's actions work when the game starts (scripts enable and disable maps while it runs). |
| `map` | string | yes |   | The map's name. |
| `remove` | boolean | no |   | Removes the map and its actions (no other change may be given). |
| `rename` | string | no |   | A new name for the map. |
